coverageChecks.stockCommandListMatchesAdapter: packages/omp-adapter/test/rpc-inventory.test.ts locks 42 names against source-inventory.json; adapter source list currently excludes the 8 Cedia patch commands by design.
coverageChecks.dispatcher: upstream/omp/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/rpc-mode.ts dispatches every stock and patch command in its handleCommand switch.
coverageChecks.hostGateway: apps/host/src/service.ts accepts stock and CEDIA_UI_COMMAND_TYPES, dispatches through request/requestCedia, and records frames.
coverageChecks.fullCoverageRule: A capability is not complete merely because the generic command route accepts it: each entry needs a named CEDIA surface, owner, capability marker, and fixture/runtime acceptance test.
